title: Go Away Pumpkin Blur!
description: Removes the annoying pumpkin blur when wearing pumpkins.
body: This texture pack makes the pumpkin way less annoying in Minecraft by removing the blur the pumpkin gives to you. It makes the screen way cleaner. Either you got curse of binding carved pumpkin from a prank or don't want to make endermen angry, this texture pack helps a lot!
